description: Does the extractor find the decisions, owners, risks and blockers a careful reader would? Each case is a short source and the claims it must yield. Matching is by claim type and key words, not exact wording. Small cases on purpose: they cover one skill each, so a drop points at what broke.

# Planning notes

## Decisions
- Use the existing campus single sign-on for staff login. Reason: staff already have accounts and nobody has to reset passwords.

## Risks
- The kiosk touch screen firmware is out of warranty and has no spare unit.

## Open questions
- Do we need a parental waiver for under-13 members?
